t: In front of you in Parliament Square stands a bronze statue of David Lloyd George, made by the sculptor Glynn Williams. Lloyd George was a Welsh Liberal who served as Prime Minister from 1916 to 1922. He is known for leading the country through the First World War, for his social reforms, for his role at the Paris Peace Conference, and for negotiating the establishment of the Irish Free State. Glynn Williams, who was born in 1939, worked as an abstract artist before turning to figurative sculpture in the late 1970s.
